Cc: contracts@saffroncore.com
Date: Tue, 04 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Major latency/error spike this morning — request for RCA and timeline

Avery / Kimberly,

Wanted to flag a serious incident we saw 04:00–07:30 PDT this morning where our API calls to your hosted endpoint returned 5xx errors and median latency spiked to ~1.8s (baseline ~220ms). This impacted our checkout flow — we estimate ~2.1% of live transactions failed.

We need:
- Immediate summary of root cause and whether any customer data was affected
- Concrete mitigations and owners + dates for fixes
- ETA for a formal RCA and remediation register we can share with our execs and compliance team

Our procurement/legal team is already asking for timelines (cc'd). Please advise urgency and when we can expect documentation.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Head of Engineering, Integrations
SaffronCore

Subject: Re: Major latency/error spike this morning — request for RCA and timeline

Elena — thanks for the prompt heads-up and apologies for the disruption. We're treating this as a top-priority account incident.

Short answers up front:
- No evidence of customer data exfiltration; logs and KV-cache snapshots show normal access patterns.
- We will share a preliminary incident summary within 6 hours and a full RCA + action register by EOD Thursday (2028-04-06).
- Owners and short-term mitigations below; we'll confirm during the readout.

Immediate mitigations (owners):
- Traffic shaping rollback to safe profile (on-call infra): jonas_weber
- Emergency autoscale policy adjustment and hotfix across dedicated pool: kimberly_park
- Customer-facing status notes and compensations discussion: me (avery_johnson) + neha_kapoor

I will schedule a 30-minute executive readout for Thursday 11:00 PDT with SaffronCore and our leadership. Ravi — can you confirm availability?

I’ll attach the interim diagnostics in a follow-up.

—Avery
Avery Johnson
Director, Customer Success (Strategy)
Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: SaffronCore incident — quick owner sync

Team — tagging a quick plan and what I need from each of you in the next 2 hours. This is an exec-level issue for the customer; they want a written RCA and an action register with committed dates.

Brief timeline (internal):
- 04:00 PDT: sudden spike in queuing due to longer decoding times on p3-16 region; concurrent K/V cache pressure observed
- 04:10–04:55: autoscaler delayed by synthetic load ahead of burst window (race with our burst-protection logic)
- 05:00–07:30: elevated 5xx rate correlated with fallback to smaller model variant under high concurrency

Action items (owners & deliverables):
- Jonas: collect kernel/hardware telemetry and exact autoscale window traces; deliver log slice and root-cause hypothesis v1 by 12:00 PDT
- Kimberly: coordinate hotfix rollout for autoscale policy and a safe-config rollback; supply canary plan and expected latency delta by 13:00 PDT
- Neha: draft customer-facing incident summary and compensation proposal; include measurable customer impact (transactions failed, revenue estimate) by 15:00 PDT
- Marissa: ops playbook update — ensure runbook includes this autoscale edge-case and adjust runbook test vector by Friday EOD

I'll consolidate and send the preliminary notes to Elena and Ravi after 2pm. Keep the thread tight — avoid replying-all unless required.

Thanks,
Avery

Date: Thu, 06 Apr 2028 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: SaffronCore incident RCA and action register (deliverable)

Elena / Ravi — thanks for joining the readout earlier. Attached are: 1) a concise RCA PDF and 2) the action register with owners and target dates. High-level summary below and then the attachments.

Executive summary:
- Root cause: race between autoscaler windowing and a decoding latency regression on p3-16 instances caused sustained queueing; in several AZs the fallback path to a smaller model variant increased error surface under high concurrency.
- Customer impact: 2.1% of transactions failed during the window; median latency observed 1.8s, 95th 3.9s. No PII exposure found.
- Mitigations delivered: immediate safe-profile rollback, emergency autoscale policy revert, and targeted kernel patch applied to the serving runtime.

Action register (highlights):
- Autoscale policy hardening & additional test coverage — owner: kimberly_park — target: 2028-04-13
- Add pre-burst synthetic-run to canary suite to detect similar regressions — owner: marissa_cole — target: 2028-04-08
- Improved tracing correlation for customer-side SDKs — owner: jonas_weber — target: 2028-04-11
- Customer SLA reconciliation and remediation statement — owner: neha_kapoor — target: 2028-04-07

Requested next steps from SaffronCore:
1) Confirm if the attached action register and dates are acceptable for exec communications
2) If you need a formal credit calculation, indicate preferred format (one-line estimate for CFO vs full invoice-level breakdown)

Attachments: saffron_rca_v1.pdf (PDF, 420KB); saffron_action_register.xlsx (Excel, 38KB)

I'll keep the weekly follow-up cadence until all items are closed — suggesting Thursdays 11:00 PDT. If execs prefer a different cadence, we can adjust.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Director, Customer Success (Strategy)
Redwood Inference
